tldr: Venus through the 10th house brings focus to career, reputation, authority, and public contribution.
body: Venus transiting the 10th house softens career, reputation, authority, and public contribution. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports visibility, leadership, and professional direction: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or measuring worth only by public success.
advice: Receive and refine in the 10th house deliberately. Work with career, reputation, authority, and public contribution without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
